name: Christmas Season
statusMeaning: Calls something that is on Kiln's roadmap. Parts of it may already run.

description: Lightweight Christmas event for Paper, Purpur, Folia and Fabric with biome snow, global snowstorms, decoration drops, gifts, elves and snowmen, controlled via the /xmas command.
